run_evals_slurm: run slurm evals for a language and set of checkpoints with configurable tasks and tokenizer
launch_slurm_job: launch a slurm job by writing an sbatch script to a temp file and submitting it
run_evals_parallel: run parallel slurm array jobs for multiple checkpoints with a specified concurrency limit
run_evals_offline: run evals in offline mode to skip dataset downloading from huggingface
run_evals_with_dependency: run slurm evals with a dependency on another job to ensure execution order
